summary:
Comprehensive technical implementation plan for extending AegisShield with:
1. Allow & Block Access Control Engine (processes, hashes, and IP addresses)
2. Automated & On-Demand Email Reporting System (SMTP with HTML security reports)
3. Network Intelligence & Origin Tracer (process network usage, IP geolocation, reverse DNS, and genuineness assessment)
4. Interactive Dashboard UI extensions and REST API endpoints
